resources.title: Retained CMX serialized task lifecycle and sleep source
locators: valid/callable/due/wait_on: admission, full sequence refusal and deadline checks
cmx_task_add/cmx_schedule: raw slot generation and fixed-priority state selection
cmx_sleep/cmx_tick/cmx_cancel: exact sleep admission, due wake and cancellation
cmx_exit/cmx_reap: retained owner refusal, EXITED state and generation increment
resources.edition: Retained repository source, C17 plus explicit Cortex/GNU conventions
resources.access: Repository source inspected directly; assessor implementation stays restricted
resources.reason: Compose the actual task/exception producer rather than substituting a simulation.

inspection.method: Read actual named source bodies and declarations, then inspect their compilation/guest behavior separately.
inspection.scope: valid/callable/due/wait_on: admission, full sequence refusal and deadline checks; cmx_task_add/cmx_schedule: raw slot generation and fixed-priority state selection; cmx_sleep/cmx_tick/cmx_cancel: exact sleep admission, due wake and cancellation; cmx_exit/cmx_reap: retained owner refusal, EXITED state and generation increment
inspection.limits: Actual bounded function bodies read; not a new review of every synchronization implementation in this file.
